adjustment_rule: Start from the recipe's initial reference; it stays acceptable unless the diff does not touch the requested behavior.
Also accept integration_tests when the diff changes behavior in two or more modules across an HTTP/service/export/storage boundary.
Also accept security_review when the diff changes code that decides which actor may see or change a document.
Also accept targeted_tests when the diff's whole change sits inside one pure validation or formatting function.
Never consult oracle outcomes, seeded-tree diagnostics, or any selector answer when applying this rule.
